english.title: Use goods vehicle for hire / reward / connection with a trade / business without an operators licence

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Goods Vehicles Licensing of Operators Act 1995

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), for the carriage of goods for

(A)_[hire or reward]_
(B)_[or in connection with a trade or business carried on by you]_

without an operator's licence issued under the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2(5) of the Goods Vehicles (Licensing of Operators) Act 1995.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket £300 .

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
